P1.quote: | Schema per tenant | About 6,000 tables and every migration run 200 times. Catalog bloat and migration failures would eat your team's time. |

P2.quote: | Database per tenant | The strongest isolation, but 200 databases to patch, back up and monitor. It's only worth it for a customer who pays for it. |

P3.quote: Take the tenant ID only from the verified token or session, never from the request body, URL or headers.

P4.quote: Every tenant-owned table gets a `tenant_id`, and PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS) enforces isolation in the database, not only in the Node code.

P5.quote: Add cross-tenant tests: two tenants, then attempt read, update, delete and insert-with-foreign-ID on every table and endpoint, and expect zero effect.

P6.quote: Don't say "physically separate", because it isn't.
